Language models

Install recognition models on this device. Review the source and limitations before installing.

Install Leafnote

Open this app over trusted HTTPS. Use your browser’s Install app or Add to Home Screen option. On iPhone or iPad, open the Share menu in Safari and choose Add to Home Screen.

Wait for “Offline notebook ready” before disconnecting. Install handwriting models while connected to your local server.

Save notes on your Linux server?

Sync keeps a copy on the server and on this device. You can keep writing offline; changes merge when this app reconnects. Conflicting edits are kept as copies.

The storage folder is chosen during Linux setup. Paste that server’s private connection code to enable sync on this device.

A different address has separate browser storage. Export your notebook, open the new server, import the backup before enabling sync, then pair with that server’s code. Your current notebook is kept here.

Open new server

Run this command from the Leafnote source folder on your Linux server. It stops sync, copies and checks the entire notebook and Git history, updates the Docker mount, then restarts sync. The original directory is kept. The browser cannot remount a Docker folder. 

Enter a new folder.

Content totals include Trash. Device and server copies are measured separately. Browser storage is managed by the browser; an operating-system folder path is not exposed.
